import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class P1047D {
    static char[][] grid;
    static int R, C;
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(in.readLine());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(in.readLine());
        int min = Math.min(n, m);
        int max = Math.max(n, m);
        if (min == 1)
            out.println(max/6*6 + 2* Math.max(0, max%6-3));
        else if (min == 2 && max == 2)
            out.println(0);
        else if (min == 2 && max == 3)
            out.println(4);
        else if (min == 3 && max == 3)
            out.println(8);
        else if (min == 2 && max == 7)
            out.println(12);
        else if (max % 2 == 0)
            out.println(min*max);
        else 
            out.println(min*max - min*max % 2);
        out.close();
    }
    private static boolean can(int cur, int r, int c) {
        if (cur > R * C / 2) {
            return true;
        }
        if (c >= C) {
            return can(cur, r+1, 0);
        }
        if (grid[r][c] != 0) {
            return can(cur, r, c+1);
        }
        grid[r][c] = (char) (65 + cur);
        for (int dr = 0; dr <= 3; dr++) {
            for (int dc = -2; dc <= 3; dc++) {
                if (dr + Math.abs(dc) != 3) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (ok(r+dr, c+dc)) {
                    grid[r+dr][c+dc] = (char) (65 + cur);
                    if (can(cur+1, r, c+1))
                        return true;
                    grid[r+dr][c+dc] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        grid[r][c] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    private static boolean ok(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < R && c < C && grid[r][c] == 0;
    }
}
